items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Fats Gordon -- I picked a couple of other trombone players. Change the whole (inaudible) brass section.

ctx.x: I say, "Look" -- he say, "You can have my whole brass section. I'm breaking up the band. I'm going to stay out here and write."
And I took like (inaudible), Fats Sleepy I used to call him. Fats Gordon -- I picked a couple of other trombone players.
